---
title: "Build, Test, and CI"
description: "Developer builds, unit tests, regression tests, and pull-request checks."
audience: developer
status: current
last-reviewed: "2026-09-06"
---

Use a debug build with unit tests for local development:

A Fortran compiler is required for the fetched reference LAPACK backend (for
example `gfortran`). CMake downloads BLAS, LAPACK and LAPACKE from the pinned
Reference-LAPACK 3.12.1 archive and verifies its SHA-256. These libraries build
under the build directory's `_deps/`; a system LAPACK installation is not needed.
Use `-DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=/path/to/compiler` to select a compiler explicitly.
The dependency is static, position-independent, real double precision with the
32-bit integer interface. Its own tests and examples are disabled; OPALX includes
eigenpair and coupled-map tests. LAPACK's upstream Fortran optimization policy is
retained; it does not change OPALX's C++ Release flags.

The backend is host-side and serial, even in GPU builds. It introduces no GPU
copies or MPI collectives into optics. Runtime deployments must provide the
selected Fortran compiler runtime (for GNU on Ubuntu, `libgfortran5`). CI build
jobs install the compiler; the serial smoke-test job installs its runtime.

```bash
cmake -S . -B build_serial \
  -DBUILD_TYPE=Debug \
  -DPLATFORMS=SERIAL \
  -DOPALX_ENABLE_UNIT_TESTS=ON
cmake --build build_serial -j 8
ctest --test-dir build_serial --output-on-failure
```

Repeat relevant tests with `OPENMP` and the target accelerator backend. A test
that passes only on the serial backend is not sufficient for a
performance-portable change.

Pull-request CI includes serial, OpenMP, CUDA, and HIP compilation, with SYCL
coverage where the runner supports it. Compile workflows run on labeled,
non-draft pull requests to `master`; use the `compile-ci` label when the change
is ready for those checks. Fast regression cases are executed with the serial
artifact and compared to maintained metrics.
